_comment: SecMon default configuration. Copy to config.json (next to secmon.py) and edit; config.json wins over this file. JSON has no comments, so explanatory fields are prefixed with underscore.
_interval_seconds: Seconds between scan rounds in daemon mode (60-600 recommended).
_heavy_interval_rounds: Services / scheduled tasks / IFEO / StartupApproved are diffed every N rounds (heavy snapshot).
_sha1_max_bytes: SHA1 is computed only for NEW files, and skipped above this size (50 MB).
_max_dir_entries: Directories with more entries than this are skipped (add game/cache dirs to exclude_dirs).
_score_thresholds: >=7 high (notify + desktop bat + URGENT.txt), 3-6 warn, <3 info.

allowlist._comment: Manage with: secmon.py allow <path-or-signer>. Signers are matched as case-insensitive substrings of the certificate subject, e.g. allow "CN=Microsoft Windows".

_exclude_dirs: Absolute paths (env vars allowed) skipped by the file watcher, e.g. "D:\\Games".
_watch_dirs: null = built-in defaults: Startup x2 (depth 2), ProgramData (2), Downloads/Desktop (3), AppData Roaming/Local (2), Temp (1), user profile root (1). Override as [[path, depth], ...].

ai._comment: Three modes: 'recommend' (default, AI only when you double-click the desktop bat), 'patrol' (AI runs automatically: immediately on high alerts + on a timer), 'off' (local heuristics only, never calls AI).
ai._backend_path: 'auto' detects kimi.exe (~/.kimi-code/bin/kimi.exe, then PATH). Any CLI that maps '<bin> -p "prompt"' to text on stdout works; override backend_args if yours differs.
ai._max_calls_per_day: Daily AI-call circuit breaker (patrol mode). Manual ai-review is never blocked.
ai._patrol_interval_minutes: patrol mode: run one routine patrol this often, even without alerts.
ai._patrol_immediate_cooldown_minutes: patrol mode: high alerts trigger an immediate patrol at most once per cooldown window (alerts merge inside the window).

patrol._allow_auto_quarantine: DANGEROUS. When true the patrol prompt permits moving high-confidence malware into quarantine. Default false: the AI is strictly read-only and only reports.

notify._balloon: Windows balloon notification on high alerts (non-blocking PowerShell NotifyIcon; silently skipped if it fails).
notify._desktop_bat: On high alerts (recommend/off modes) drop 'SecMon-运行AI研判.bat' on the desktop for one-click AI review.
